versions.content: The API Dem_SetStorageCondition shall trigger the call- back function InitMonitorForEvent of the related event(s) in case a storage con- dition of the event(s) is changed to fulfilled and thus all storage conditions of the event(s) are fulfilled. Furthermore the callback shall only be called, if the event did report FAILED or PASSED while the storage condition was disabled. The Init- MonitorReason parameter shall be set to DEM_INIT_MONITOR_REENABLED .
